decisions.reason: As an organic extension in the firm's stated growth direction that remained on the website through 2024, Product A has enough strategic fit and visible commitment for management to continue backing it.

Although organic and close to the core range, Product B vanished from the website by 2024, suggesting results disappointed enough that even escalation of commitment no longer outweighs the weak market signal.
Product C stayed visible in 2024 and fits the firm's premium snack assortment, so prior launch investment and public positioning make management likely to continue with it.
As a 2024 organic launch with its own page and direct link to the firm's announced expansion of organic lines, Product D would likely be retained to justify the recent investment.

Product E is a very recent organic format innovation with strong website visibility and strategic fit, so management would likely attribute any early shortfalls to temporary ramp-up effects and keep it.
Product F is another 2024 organic salami extension with its own page, and the combination of fresh investment, close fit to capabilities, and public commitment favors keeping it.
